guide.basics.title: Basics
guide.basics.body: Write expressions in plain math notation. Multiplication can be implicit (2x, 3 sin(x)). Use := to assign, = for equations, and end a line with ; to hide its result. % refers to the previous result, %n to the result of step n.
guide.algebra.title: Algebra
guide.algebra.body: Exact rational arithmetic, polynomial algebra and equation solving.
guide.calculus.title: Calculus
guide.calculus.body: Derivatives, integrals (indefinite and definite), limits, series and sums.
guide.ode.title: Differential equations
guide.ode.body: Write derivatives with primes. Add initial conditions as extra equations.
guide.linalg.title: Linear algebra
guide.linalg.body: Matrices are lists of rows. * multiplies matrices; ^ takes matrix powers.
guide.plotting.title: Plotting
guide.plotting.body: Drag to pan, scroll to zoom, double-click to reset. 3D plots rotate when dragged.
guide.numbers.title: Numbers
guide.precision.title: Precision
guide.precision.body: N(expr, digits) evaluates to any number of significant digits; identify recognises exact constants from decimals.
guide.checking.title: Checking work
guide.checking.body: check takes a worked solution as text and checks every step: the first line is the task, each following line one step.
guide.assumptions.title: Assumptions
guide.assumptions.body: Variables are complex unless you say otherwise. assume(x > 0) or assume(n, integer) refine results; forget(x) removes them.
fn.diff: Derivative of f with respect to x (n-th derivative, or mixed partials).
fn.integrate: Indefinite or definite integral. Definite integrals fall back to numeric quadrature when needed.
fn.nintegrate: Numerical integration (adaptive Gauss–Kronrod; infinite limits allowed).
fn.limit: Limit of f as x → a (two-sided, or one-sided with "+" / "-"). a may be oo or -oo.
fn.series: Taylor/Laurent series of f about x = a up to order n (default a = 0, n = 6).
fn.sum: Sum of f for k from a to b (b may be oo or symbolic), or the total of a list.
fn.product: Product of f for k from a to b.
fn.jacobian: Jacobian matrix of a vector function.
fn.dsolve: Solves ordinary differential equations (separable, linear first order, linear constant-coefficient). Write derivatives as y', y''.
fn.simplify: Tries algebraic, rational and trigonometric transformations and returns the simplest form (optionally under extra assumptions).
fn.check: Checks a worked solution line by line: each step must follow from the previous one, and the final answer must solve the first line (an equation, system, inequality or expression to transform).
fn.checklatex: Like check, with the steps written in LaTeX (as produced by handwriting recognition).
fn.assume: Declares assumptions about variables (inequalities with a number, or real, integer, positive, negative, nonnegative, nonpositive, nonzero, natural). They refine results from then on.
fn.forget: Removes assumptions about the given variables (all of them without arguments).
fn.refine: Re-evaluates an expression under the current (plus extra) assumptions: sqrt(x^2) → x, abs, sign, (−1)^(2n), sin(n π), ...
fn.is: Decides a condition from the assumptions: True, False or Unknown.
fn.factor: Factors polynomials and rational functions over the rationals.
fn.sqrfree: Square-free factorisation: a product of powers of pairwise coprime square-free polynomials.
fn.polydiv: Polynomial division in x: [quotient, remainder] with p = quotient·q + remainder.
fn.quo: Quotient of polynomial division in x.
fn.rem: Remainder of polynomial division in x.
fn.resultant: Resultant of two polynomials in x (zero exactly when they share a root).
fn.discriminant: Discriminant of a polynomial in x (zero exactly when it has a repeated root).
fn.together: Combines a sum of fractions over a common denominator.
fn.cancel: Cancels common factors between numerator and denominator.
fn.collect: Groups terms by powers of x.
fn.coeffs: Coefficients of a polynomial, from the constant term upwards.
fn.degree: Degree of a polynomial in x.
fn.solve: Solves equations and systems exactly where possible (numerically otherwise).
fn.nsolve: Real roots found numerically (in [-100, 100] by default, or in [a, b]).
fn.N: Numerical value: machine precision, or the given number of significant digits.
fn.identify: Recognises a decimal number as an exact constant (rational, algebraic of small degree, combinations of π, e, logs and square roots).
fn.diag: Diagonal matrix from a list (or the diagonal of a matrix).
fn.norm: Euclidean norm of a vector (Frobenius norm of a matrix).
fn.linsolve: Solves the linear system A·x = b.
fn.table: List of expr for i from a to b.
fn.dims: Dimensions of a list or matrix.
fn.plot: 2D plot of one or more functions of x. Drag to pan, scroll to zoom.
fn.plot3d: Surface plot of f(x, y). Drag to rotate.
fn.text: Linear text form of an expression.
fn.clear: Removes values/definitions of variables or functions.
fn.clearall: Removes all variables, functions and history.
fn.help: Describes a command, or lists all commands.
